01 — About

The story behind the profile.

I've always sat comfortably at the meeting point of two worlds — the structured logic of business and the restless pull of new technology. That tension is what keeps me curious.

At United International University, I'm completing my BBA in my tenth trimester with a 3.65 CGPA, building on an academic record that carried a 4.83 GPA through higher secondary. But the classroom was never the whole story. I spent a year and a half on the ground with the Bangladesh Red Crescent Youth, ran a national Blockchain Olympiad campaign as a finalist, promoted brands on the retail floor, and moderated growing online communities.

Whether I'm at a podium with a microphone or building a pitch, my instinct is the same: take something complex and make it feel simple, human, and worth trusting.

Curious by default

I move toward what I don't yet understand — from blockchain to data tools.

Clear communicator

Public speaking and community work taught me to make ideas land.

Steady under pressure

Crowd handling and continuous service built calm in fast-moving rooms.

Creative eye

Photography, drawing and cinematography sharpen how I see and tell stories.
